caption: The drawing depicts a painted wooden statue of a standing human figure positioned on a rectangular base. The figure wears a long garment that is yellow with a brown lower section and has gray sleeves, as well as yellow cuffs and a yellow collar. The figure has brown skin and holds a rectangular, brown object in its left hand, while its right hand appears to be holding small round items, possibly beads, strung in a line at its waist. The figure has dark shoes, greenish stockings, and wears a dark band or headpiece around its short hair. The base on which the figure stands is painted primarily in shades of brown and yellow, with visible signs of wear or texture on the surface. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or features.
title: Tea importer's sign
